column4: cleat#2312: all three call testDB(t) (engine/fault_test.go), which opens a *PostgresStore directly via testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectPostgres) -- skips on CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES (fallback CLEAT_TEST_DB) alone regardless of what else is set, since the sensitive-column encryption this PR adds is PostgreSQL-only (--encrypt-sensitive-payloads already refuses every other --driver), so these three have no MySQL or MSSQL form to run instead. multi-db/mysql sets CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so all three skip here. 3 skips, not a subtest group -- each test is its own top-level skip, same shape as a-keyless-worker-cannot-recognise-sealed-history.tsv's PayloadEncryptionEverEnabled/MarkPayloadEncryptionEnabled pair. Measured locally: `go test ./engine/ -run 'TestWorkflowInstanceColumnsAreEncrypted|TestSignalPromiseAndUpdatePayloadsAreEncrypted|TestScheduleAndChildWorkflowInputAreEncrypted' -json` with no CLEAT_TEST_* set reports exactly these three names skipping and nothing else.
same three tests, same reason: multi-db/mssql sets CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so all three skip here too -- see the multi-db/mysql line above.
